To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the application of clustering techniques in collaborative recommender framework can be beneficial to enhance the effectiveness of the system.
the application of semantic contents in the collaborative recommander framework can enhance the effectiveness of the collaborative recommendation.

(1) the collaborative filtering recommender system with semantic content information obtained through user profile construction is more effective than the one without such information; (2) the collaborative filtering system with semantic content and rating information obtained through user profiles is more effective than that with rating information alone.

the development of a new collaborative recommender framework which is based on clustering technique to consider semantic content information from the user profiles.
the construction of user profiles and their applications to recommender systems.
how to improve the accuracy of collaborative recommendation by using the semantic content information.
